objective: Physically accept the general frame-streaming primitive: an arbitrary precomputed 16x16 RGB888 frame set played through the already-proven typed session transaction, with no new route, encoder, transport or Host build.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target required before any socket is created

transport.connection_shape: one persistent RFCOMM connection for this bounded session; one ACK per frame; no retry, reconnect or pipelining
transport.one_controller_rule: the persistent MCP product supervisor must be stopped for this session and restarted immediately afterward; the Android Divoom app must stay disconnected; OpenTivoo runtime/task/port 8779 remain untouched
transport.host_change: none; /v1/session/frame already accepts an arbitrary 768-byte RGB888 frame

build.installed_identity_note: Verified in-session 2026-09-09: the repository Release build and the deployed %LOCALAPPDATA%\\OpenDitoo\\Day1Host DLL are byte-identical at this hash. Streaming adds WSL Python only; no Windows rebuild.

session.shape: one connection; 48 distinct frames dispatched at the 200 ms client cadence under the 150 ms Host floor; change-only scheduling holds nothing because every frame differs; then close
session.semantic_evidence: No new device command semantics. Each frame is the same stock-derived Pixel Coloring image transaction already accepted at M5/M8/M9 and measured through R1-R5; only the pixel content varies.

stream.source_description: deterministic generated sweep-bar demo: a 1-pixel vertical bar crossing left to right once in red, once in green, once in blue, on black; generated offline by scripts/make_stream_demo_frames.py

budgets.derivation: 48 distinct frames at 200 ms is 9.6 s of playback inside a 12 s lifetime, so the clip bounds the frame count, not the clock. 48 x 3 packets; worst-case 71 application bytes per frame (image packet plus both stock preambles) gives the byte ceiling.

expected_observations.transport: one connection, 48 ACKed frames, 144 application packets, 3408 application bytes, clean lifetime_expired or budget_exhausted close
expected_observations.physical: three visible left-to-right sweeps of a single-column bar -- red, then green, then blue -- over about 9.6 s, then the final blue column held until the lifetime ends
expected_observations.interpretation: Proves the general precomputed-frame streaming path on the exact unit. It proves nothing about video preprocessing, live generation, audio sync, pipelining or rates above the tested cadence.

persistence_analysis.source_state_effect: none; no MCP source collection runs in a stream session
persistence_analysis.product_policy_effect: none; the product policy and its hash-frozen code are untouched

stop_immediately_on: unexpected target identity or pairing precheck failure
any unsolicited state report on the link (canvas is no longer ours)
any inbound bytes that do not parse as exactly one valid wrapped report
any ACK that is not our wrapped 0x44 shape with a single payload byte
any send that does not complete in full
the worker falling silent for longer than the Host grace period
stop_policy.on_ambiguous_outcome: stop sending, close the link, record completed/unknown bytes and last known display state; never resend, reconnect or reclaim
stop_policy.recovery: restart the already-authorized persistent product service after the stream returns

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE execution only of OPENDITOO-S1-STREAM-001: stop the persistent MCP product supervisor, stream the frozen 48-frame sweep-bar demo set (frame_set_sha256 6abd7a835fb243f705207384a0262910e21019222c5e409c8272acd3178fe20e) to exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7 through the existing typed /v1/session/* transaction at a 200 ms client cadence over a 12 s bounded lifetime (48 frames, 144 packets, 3408 application bytes, one connection, one ACK per frame), then restart the persistent product supervisor; no retry, reconnect, reclaim, pipelining, raw send, target override, firmware or persistent write.

explicitly_out_of_scope: camera, game or screen capture sources
cadence faster than the tested client dispatch rate
raw send, target selection or command enumeration
firmware, gallery or any persistent write
any target other than the exact unit
